what: Hand-written requests for the copilot's language model, and what each one means. NONE of these came from ai/language_corpus.py: they were written separately, in the words an engineer would actually use, including typos, abbreviations, domain slang, requests that combine several asks, and requests the app cannot do at all. This is the set the model is MEASURED on, because measuring on text from the training templates measures memorisation of the templates.
scoring: intents: the set of things the model should act on, per request. parts: for placement intents, which parts the constraint applies to. A request whose intents are [] must produce nothing at all -- the model has to say it did not understand rather than apply the nearest match.
